editor.label: Step CA
editor.description: Sign in through your identity provider and let your Step CA issue a short-lived SSH certificate for this host. The CA URL, root fingerprint and OIDC provisioner are set by an administrator in the Step CA plugin settings.

dialog.title: Step CA Authentication Required
dialog.description: Complete authentication in your browser to continue. The certificate stays valid for as long as your CA allows.

errors.authFailed: Authentication failed. Please check your credentials and try again.
errors.timeout: Authentication timed out. Please try again.

caUrl.label: CA URL
caUrl.description: The https URL of your smallstep CA. Leave the CA URL, fingerprint and provisioner empty to turn Step CA off.

fingerprint.label: Root fingerprint (SHA-256)
fingerprint.description: The root certificate fingerprint, as shown by step ca bootstrap.

provisioner.label: OIDC provisioner name
provisioner.description: The name of the CA's OIDC provisioner. Then choose "Step CA" as a host's authentication type.

privateEndpoints.label: Allowed private Step CA hosts
privateEndpoints.description: Private hosts the Step CA certificate flow may contact: the CA itself and, if internal, your identity provider. Separate them with commas or new lines.

redirectUri.label: Redirect URI
redirectUri.description: Register this URL as an allowed redirect URI with the identity provider behind the OIDC provisioner.

legacyCallback.label: Use the old redirect URI
legacyCallback.description: Keep sending /host/step-ca-callback, the redirect URI used before 2.9. Turn this off once your identity provider allows the new one.
